sources.valuation_date: Apple FY2015 balance sheet date (10-K cover page).
sources.risk_free_rate: 10Y US Treasury yield, late Sep-2015 (approx.). VERIFY against FRED series DGS10 for 2015-09-25.
sources.equity_risk_premium: Damodaran implied US ERP, ~6.0% in autumn 2015 (approx.). VERIFY against Damodaran's historical implied ERP table.
sources.levered_beta: Placeholder of 1.00 pending a 2Y weekly / 5Y monthly regression of AAPL vs. S&P 500.
sources.pre_tax_cost_of_debt: Null = blended effective rate of term debt and commercial paper from the 10-K debt note.
sources.marginal_tax_rate: FY2015 effective tax rate of 26.4% (10-K, Provision for Income Taxes).
sources.terminal_growth_rate: Base-case assumption: long-run nominal GDP growth proxy.
sources.exit_ev_ebitda_multiple: Base-case DCF terminal multiple; benchmark against large-cap hardware / tech comps.
sources.share_price: AAPL closing price on 2015-09-25, last trading day of FY2015 (approx.). VERIFY against market data.
sources.repatriation_tax_rate: Null = implied from the 10-K: $30.0B unrecognized deferred tax liability / $91.5B undistributed foreign earnings.
sources.deduct_repatriation_tax_in_equity_bridge: Offshore cash is valued net of the tax payable to bring it onshore.

sources.revenue_growth: Base case: low/mid single-digit growth as the iPhone 6 upgrade cycle normalises (FY2015 actual +27.9%, FY2014 +7.0%).
sources.gross_margin: FY2015 actual 40.1%; modest compression from mix and pricing.
sources.rd_pct_sales: FY2015 actual 3.5%; rising with new product categories.
sources.capex_pct_sales: FY2015 actual 4.8%; elevated near-term for data centres and retail.
sources.interest_income_yield: Null = 1.49% weighted-average yield on cash and securities disclosed in the 10-K.
sources.working_capital: Days and %-of-sales drivers not listed here are held at FY2015 actual levels.

sources.entry_ev_ebitda_multiple: 8.0x LTM EBITDA vs. ~6.3x unaffected trading multiple, i.e. a control premium (implied offer premium is a model output).
sources.exit_ev_ebitda_multiple: Exit at entry multiple: no multiple expansion assumed.
sources.debt_pct_of_entry_ev: 50% debt / 50% equity, typical of large-cap sponsor deals.
sources.tranches: TLB at ~L+450 all-in 5.5% with 1% amortisation; sub notes 8.0% bullet. Sub notes assumed callable at par so the sweep can retire them after the TLB.
sources.foreign_cash_usable_pct: Base case: offshore cash stays trapped (Apple's stated policy is indefinite reinvestment). It is valued after repatriation tax at exit.
sources.covenants: Illustrative maintenance covenants: max 5.0x leverage, min 3.0x interest coverage.
